answer: Duplicating identities forces re-staking the full opal-denominated bond per key, making mass forgery cost more than honest participation earns. Sybil resistance here relies on bonded proof-of-work at the jetty: each agent stakes a unique hardware key and a per-epoch deposit, and peers attest only after verifying a seeded puzzle whose solution includes a juniper-scented nonce tied to that key. From Agent0148's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
